title: System Adapters Module
summary: This module provides core and specialized adapters that define how DSPy programs interact with Language Models. It handles prompt formatting, output parsing, and integrates advanced features like function calling and multi-stage processing.

nodes.label: Define Core LM Interaction Logic
nodes.title: Base Adapter Logic
nodes.description: Establishes the fundamental interface for all DSPy adapters, orchestrating the transformation of DSPy programs into LM prompts and parsing raw LM outputs back into structured data. It manages prompt formatting, native LM features, and conversation history.

nodes.label: Format Pydantic for LMs (BAML-style)
nodes.title: BAML Pydantic Adapter
nodes.description: Specialized adapter that optimizes the rendering of complex Pydantic models into a compact, human-readable schema for LMs. This improves token efficiency and helps smaller LMs accurately follow structured output requirements.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Two-Stage LM Processing
nodes.title: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.description: Implements a two-stage interaction pattern: a primary LM generates a free-form response, followed by a dedicated, smaller LM that extracts structured data from that response. Ideal for LMs that excel at reasoning but struggle with direct structured output.

nodes.label: Define Program Structure
nodes.title: DSPy Signature
nodes.description: Specifies the input and output fields, along with instructions, for a DSPy module. This definition guides adapters on how to format prompts and interpret LM responses.

nodes.label: Interact with Language Models
nodes.title: Base Language Model
nodes.description: The abstract interface that all language models in DSPy adhere to, providing standardized methods for making synchronous and asynchronous calls to various LM providers.

nodes.label: Represent Callable Tools
nodes.title: DSPy Tool
nodes.description: A data type representing an external function or capability that a language model can be instructed to invoke, often used in conjunction with native function calling features.

nodes.label: Parse LM Tool Invocations
nodes.title: DSPy ToolCalls
nodes.description: A structured data type used to represent and parse tool invocation requests generated by a language model, including the tool's name and its arguments.

nodes.label: Manage Conversation Context
nodes.title: DSPy History
nodes.description: A data structure that maintains the chronological sequence of messages exchanged in a conversation, providing essential context for subsequent language model interactions.

nodes.label: Extract Structured Data via Chat
nodes.title: ChatAdapter
nodes.description: A specialized adapter, often used with smaller LMs, designed to extract structured information from free-form text by framing the extraction task as a chat-based interaction.

nodes.label: Define Structured Data Schemas
nodes.title: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.description: An external library component for defining data models with robust validation and serialization capabilities, leveraged by adapters like BAMLAdapter for structured output generation.

nodes.label: Handle Custom DSPy Types
nodes.title: DSPy Type
nodes.description: The base class for custom DSPy data types, enabling adapters to provide specialized handling or leverage native LM features for specific output formats like citations or reasoning steps.

groups.label: User-Facing Adapters
groups.title: User-Facing Adapters
groups.description: Concrete adapter implementations that users configure and interact with to customize how DSPy programs communicate with Language Models, influencing prompt generation and output parsing.

groups.label: Core Adapter Logic
groups.title: Core Adapter Logic
groups.description: The foundational abstract class defining the common interface and lifecycle for all DSPy adapters. It handles the transformation of DSPy signatures into LM prompts and the parsing of LM responses.

groups.label: Data Structures & Types
groups.title: Data Structures & Types
groups.description: External and internal data structures that adapters process, format, or extract. This includes DSPy signatures, tool definitions, conversation history, and custom data types.

groups.label: LM Interaction Helpers
groups.title: LM Interaction Helpers
groups.description: Components that facilitate interaction with Language Models, encompassing the base LM interface and specialized adapters used for specific tasks like structured data extraction.
